# K1 — always-loaded surface (CLAUDE.md + decision register), product inputs, root build assets

@@ output/template/CLAUDE.md ;; Always loaded (project memory); imports docs/architecture/decision-register.md.
@scope always (planning-time, all work)
1 NN ;; Banner (kind, scope, capability, loading metadata).
3 NN ;; Heading.
5 IM ;; Import of the decision register.
7 NN ;; Descriptive template statement and maintainer-map pointer.
9 NN ;; Heading.
11 EX [x.vocab-default-report]
13 NN ;; Heading.
15 OL [gov001.spec-authoritative]
16 OL [gov003.no-invent]
17 OL [gov004.propose-ask]
18 OL [gov005.routine-delegated]
19 OL [gov006.string-semantics]
20 OL [gov008.custom-settings]
21 OL [gov009.conflict-stop]
22 OL [gov010.no-invent-tunable,gov021.sync-workflow]
23 OL [gov011.exclusions]
24 EX [x.product-inputs-no-override]
26 NN ;; Heading.
28 OL [gov017.classify]
30 OL [gov017.decided,dep002.approved-tech]
31 OL [gov017.delegated]
32 OL [gov017.reserved]
33 OL [arc020.reserved-decision-change]
34 OL [arc020.reserved-styles]
35 MX [arc020.reserved-new-project,x.reserved-refgraph] ;; New production project/layer/assembly is ARC-020; a change to the project reference graph is added.
36 OL [arc020.reserved-persistence]
37 MX [arc020.reserved-infra,x.reserved-infra-extra] ;; Messaging, background processing and distributed cache are ARC-020; search, external storage and external identity are added.
38 MX [x.reserved-major-lib,arc020.reserved-replace-baseline] ;; Replacing approved baseline technology is ARC-020/DEP-002; a new major library or framework as Reserved is added.
39 EX [x.reserved-convention]
40 OL [arc020.reserved-auth]
41 MX [api014.breaking-reserved,x.reserved-versioning] ;; Breaking public API change is API-014; adopting API versioning as Reserved is added.
42 OL [gov004.reserved-product]
43 OL [gov017.unclear-test]
44 OL [gov005.no-escalate]
45 MX [gov017.decision-request,x.instruction-as-approval] ;; Decision Request before implementation is GOV-017; explicit-instruction approval with mandatory recording via architecture-decision is added.
46 OL [gov017.headless]
48 NN ;; Heading.
50 OL [gov012.simplicity]
51 OL [gov013.no-speculative]
52 OL [gov014.scope]
53 OL [gov018.challenge]
55 NN ;; Heading.
57 OL [gov015.git-explicit]
58 OL [gov016.parallel]
60 NN ;; Heading.
62 IM ;; Routing instruction (workflows own procedure, stop conditions and report shape; run them instead of improvising).
64-65 NN ;; Table header.
66 OL [wf001.route-dev-workflow]
67 OL [wf003.route-verify]
68-77 IM ;; Routing rows (code-review/agent, build-fix, add-dependency, custom-settings, persistence-change, architecture-decision, project-structure, delivery-change, security-scan, git-workflow).
79 EX [x.template-maint-user-only]

C x.vocab-default-report EX - MUST ;; Vocabulary: a must/must-not violation is a defect; a deviation from a 'default' needs a concrete reason and must be reported; prefer/avoid are guidance; 'requires approval' marks a Reserved decision. ;; = ;; none ;; Reporting obligation for default deviations is not in the oracle.
C gov001.spec-authoritative OL GOV-001 MUST ;; A non-empty SPECIFICATION.md is authoritative for project-specific functional requirements and observable behaviour; the template file is intentionally empty. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov003.no-invent OL GOV-003 MUST_NOT ;; Must not silently weaken, contradict or materially extend specified behaviour or invent user-visible behaviour, limits, defaults, restrictions or workflows, even when they seem reasonable. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov004.propose-ask OL GOV-004 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; When an omitted detail materially affects observable behaviour propose the smallest reasonable option and ask for approval. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov005.routine-delegated OL GOV-005 DEFAULT ;; Routine internal implementation choices that do not change observable behaviour need no approval. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov006.string-semantics OL GOV-006 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Observable string semantics (case sensitivity, collation, culture vs ordinal, normalization, trimming, uniqueness, lookup) are product behaviour; choosing them when undefined requires approval. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov008.custom-settings OL GOV-008 MUST ;; Approved tunable limits and defaults live in CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md, which never overrides SPECIFICATION.md (behavioural intent). ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov009.conflict-stop OL GOV-009 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; The two files must not contradict; on apparent conflict stop and ask which source must be corrected; never choose silently. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov010.no-invent-tunable OL GOV-010 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Must not silently invent a material tunable value: propose it, obtain approval, record it in CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov021.sync-workflow OL GOV-021 MUST ;; After recording an approved tunable value synchronize it (custom-settings). ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov011.exclusions OL GOV-011 MUST_NOT ;; Must not store secrets, environment-specific connection details, package versions, HTTP status codes, ports, migration identifiers or incidental implementation constants in CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.product-inputs-no-override EX GOV-001,GOV-008 MUST_NOT ;; Product, feature and task inputs may request a decision change but must not silently override engineering policy or recorded decisions. ;; = ;; none ;; Product-input vs engineering-policy precedence not stated in the oracle.
C gov017.classify OL GOV-017 MUST ;; Classify a choice (Decided, Delegated, Reserved) before acting on it. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov017.decided OL GOV-017 MUST ;; Decided choices (decision register, standards, specification, established project structure) are followed; reopening requires approval. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep002.approved-tech OL DEP-002 MUST_NOT ;; Decided approved technology is followed rather than replaced by an alternative without approval. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov017.delegated OL GOV-017,GOV-005 DEFAULT ;; Delegated choices (local, reversible, no material boundary/dependency/convention/contract/behaviour change) are decided and implemented. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov017.reserved OL GOV-017 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Reserved choices require explicit approval before implementation; the list is a minimum. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc020.reserved-decision-change OL ARC-020 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Changing an accepted project or architecture decision, including a capability selection, is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc020.reserved-styles OL ARC-020,ARC-004,ARC-009 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; New architectural styles/patterns are Reserved: CQRS, mediators, VSA, event sourcing, microservices, Rich Domain/DDD tactical patterns, a project-wide Result model. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc020.reserved-new-project OL ARC-020 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Adding a production project, layer or assembly is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.reserved-refgraph EX ARC-020,ARC-001 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Changing the project reference graph is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;; Not gated by ARC-020.
C arc020.reserved-persistence OL ARC-020 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Changing persistence boundaries (e.g. multiple persistence contexts) or persistence technology is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc020.reserved-infra OL ARC-020 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Adding messaging, background-processing or distributed-cache infrastructure is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.reserved-infra-extra EX ARC-020 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Adding search, external storage or external identity infrastructure is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;; Beyond ARC-020's list.
C x.reserved-major-lib EX DEP-001,GOV-013 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Adding a major library or framework is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;; The oracle requires a concrete need, not approval.
C arc020.reserved-replace-baseline OL ARC-020,DEP-002 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Replacing approved baseline technology is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.reserved-convention EX ARC-020 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Introducing a project-wide convention or abstraction that other code is expected to follow is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;; Generalizes ARC-020's project-wide Result example.
C arc020.reserved-auth OL ARC-020 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Changing authentication/authorization architecture is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api014.breaking-reserved OL API-014 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; A breaking public API change is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.reserved-versioning EX API-013,DEP-017 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Adopting API versioning is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;; API-013 requires a concrete need, not approval.
C gov004.reserved-product OL GOV-004,GOV-010 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Defining product behaviour or tunable values the product sources do not define is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov017.unclear-test OL GOV-017 MUST ;; Unclear case: any 'yes' to the five questions (dependency/framework/infrastructure, project/layer/reference boundary, convention, observable behaviour/public contract, expensive to reverse) makes it Reserved. ;; = ;; Unclear cases. ;;
C gov005.no-escalate OL GOV-005,GOV-017 MUST_NOT ;; Do not escalate routine local decisions already constrained by the specification, decision register, existing code or standards. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov017.decision-request OL GOV-017 MUST ;; For a Reserved choice raise a Decision Request through architecture-decision and do not implement it before approval. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.instruction-as-approval EX GOV-017,GOV-007 MUST ;; An explicit user instruction counts as approval; the accepted decision must still be recorded through architecture-decision. ;; = ;; none ;; Recording obligation added to GOV-017.
C gov017.headless OL GOV-017 MUST_NOT ;; In autonomous/headless runs take only a policy-compliant non-Reserved path, never silently make or alter a Reserved decision, and report every unresolved Decision Request. ;; autonomous or headless runs ;; none ;;
C gov012.simplicity OL GOV-012 DEFAULT ;; Default to the simplest maintainable solution with proportional complexity and no speculative abstractions. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov013.no-speculative OL GOV-013 MUST_NOT ;; Must not introduce frameworks, libraries, infrastructure or architectural patterns without a concrete current need. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov014.scope OL GOV-014 MUST ;; Changes stay within the requested scope and preserve existing behaviour unless the task or approved specification requires a change. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov018.challenge OL GOV-018 MUST ;; Before implementing a questionable request name the concrete concern (duplication, cohesion, trigger/loading problems, context cost, architecture/policy conflict, unnecessary complexity) and propose an alternative; never silently rewrite or ignore the requirement. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov015.git-explicit OL GOV-015 MUST_NOT ;; Must not commit, push, merge, rebase, reset, force-push, delete branches or run any other repository-changing Git operation unless explicitly requested; requested operations follow git-workflow. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov016.parallel OL GOV-016 MUST ;; Parallel implementation work uses separate branches or worktrees; unrelated changes stay out of the current branch. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf001.route-dev-workflow OL WF-001 MUST ;; Implementing a feature, fix, refactor or new application runs development-workflow. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf003.route-verify OL WF-003 MUST ;; Completing implementation work runs verify. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.template-maint-user-only EX - MUST ;; Changes to this instruction system are governed by template-maintenance, which is user-invoked only. ;; repo/meta (instruction-system change) ;; none ;; Instruction-system maintenance gate not in the oracle.

@@ output/template/CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md ;; Product input (empty settings table).
@scope product input CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md
1 NN ;; Banner (kind, scope, capability, loading metadata).
3 NN ;; Heading.
5 OL [gov021.cs-run-workflow]
7-8 NN ;; Empty settings table header.

C gov021.cs-run-workflow OL GOV-021,GOV-008 MUST ;; Changes to CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md go through custom-settings; file rules are in CLAUDE.md (Product sources). ;; = ;; none ;;

@@ output/template/SPECIFICATION.md ;; Product input; empty in the template (no non-blank lines).

@@ output/template/Directory.Build.props ;; Root build asset.
@scope all .NET projects (MSBuild import)
1 NN ;; Banner comment (kind, scope, capability, loading).
2 IM ;; Conformance comment.
3 OL [dep023.shared-only]
4-5 IM ;; MSBuild structure.
6 OL [dep008.tfm]
7-8 EX [x.build-settings]
9-10 IM ;; MSBuild structure.

C dep023.shared-only OL DEP-023 DEFAULT ;; Only genuinely shared .NET build settings in Directory.Build.props; project-specific settings stay in their projects. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep008.tfm OL DEP-008 ENFORCED_DEFAULT ;; Shared target framework net10.0. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.build-settings EX DEP-023,RUN-009 ENFORCED_DEFAULT ;; Shared build settings Nullable enable and ImplicitUsings enable. ;; = ;; none ;; Concrete compiler settings not in the oracle.

@@ output/template/Directory.Packages.props ;; Root CPM asset.
@scope all NuGet package references (MSBuild import)
1 NN ;; Banner comment (kind, scope, capability, loading).
2 IM ;; Conformance comment.
3 OL [dep006.cpm-comment]
4-5 IM ;; MSBuild structure.
6 OL [dep006.cpm-enabled]
7-10 IM ;; MSBuild structure.

C dep006.cpm-comment OL DEP-006,DEP-003,DEP-004 MUST ;; Central versions are added by add-dependency after registry, license and vulnerability checks; never copy versions from examples. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep006.cpm-enabled OL DEP-006 ENFORCED ;; ManagePackageVersionsCentrally is enabled. ;; = ;; none ;;

@@ output/template/docs/architecture/decision-register.md ;; Always loaded (imported by CLAUDE.md); Decided entries and capability selection.
@scope always (planning-time, all work)
1 NN ;; Banner (kind, scope, capability, loading metadata).
3 NN ;; Heading.
5 OL [arc020.dr-change-reserved]
7 NN ;; Heading.

C arc020.dr-change-reserved OL ARC-020,GOV-017 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Register entries are Decided and followed; changing any entry is Reserved and goes through architecture-decision. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.slot-static-composition EX ARC-020 MUST ;; Static composition: exactly one implementation per required capability slot and zero or one for the optional slot; unselected implementations are not part of the runtime; each module manifest lists its facets. ;; repo/meta (capability selection) ;; none ;; Capability-slot composition rule not in the oracle.
C arc001.dr-clean-arch OL ARC-001,DEP-024 DECIDED ;; Selected architecture: clean-architecture with backend roles Domain, Application, Infrastructure, Api as backend/<Name>.<Layer>/. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc009.dr-no-mediator OL ARC-009 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Not adopted: CQRS handlers, MediatR, Kommand, VSA or similar mediator-based organization; introducing them requires explicit approval. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep009.dr-persistence OL DEP-009 DECIDED ;; Selected persistence: EF Core with SQL Server (Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer); provider concerns stay out of Application and Domain; EF Core migrations; dedicated Development seeder. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov006.dr-collation OL GOV-006 DEFINITION ;; String comparison follows database collation (SQL Server defaults are case-insensitive); observable semantics remain a product decision. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep013.dr-tests OL DEP-013,TST-001,TST-006 DECIDED ;; Selected backend testing: NUnit; test projects beside production projects under backend/; WebApplicationFactory<Program> integration baseline; Testcontainers conditional. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep014.dr-frontend OL DEP-014 DECIDED ;; Selected optional frontend: current stable Angular with compatible TypeScript/RxJS, standalone, strict, routing, zoneless when supported, SCSS, Material/CDK, Vitest. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep015.dr-not-default OL DEP-015 MUST_NOT ;; Not added by default: NgRx, Axios, Lodash, Bootstrap, Tailwind or additional form/component/state libraries; built-in Angular first; extras only for a concrete need. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep002.dr-approved-tech OL DEP-002 MUST_NOT ;; Use the approved technology; must not silently select an alternative; replacing approved technology requires approval. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep008.dr-platform OL DEP-008 DECIDED ;; .NET 10 LTS, C# 14, ASP.NET Core, Controllers; preview/RC requires approval. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep010.dr-validation OL DEP-010 DECIDED ;; FluentValidation is the standard explicit request/use-case validation library. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep010.dr-logging OL DEP-010 DECIDED ;; Application code logs through ILogger<T>; Serilog is the provider. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep012.dr-swagger OL DEP-012,API-017 DECIDED ;; Swashbuckle Swagger UI is the default Development documentation/testing surface (not built-in AddOpenApi()/MapOpenApi()); outside Development only when requirements justify it. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep022.dr-slnx OL DEP-022 DEFAULT ;; .slnx by default; legacy .sln only when an external tool or requirement needs it. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep023.dr-build-config OL DEP-023,DEP-006 DEFAULT ;; Repository-level Directory.Build.props for shared build settings and Directory.Packages.props for CPM; project-specific settings stay in their projects. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep001.dr-conditional OL DEP-001,DEP-011 MUST ;; Conditional technologies are approved but added only when the capability is actually needed. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep011.dr-mapping OL DEP-011 DEFAULT ;; Manual mapping for simple cases; Mapster when mapping volume warrants it. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep020.dr-resilience OL DEP-020,DEP-011 DEFAULT ;; Microsoft resilience packages only when a real integration needs resilience. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep016.dr-playwright OL DEP-016 DEFAULT ;; Playwright when E2E coverage is required; not part of the baseline scaffold. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep018.dr-docker OL DEP-018 MUST_NOT ;; Must not introduce Docker merely because the application can be containerized; container artifacts only when the project or deployment needs them. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep024.dr-layout OL DEP-024 DEFAULT ;; Production and backend test projects in backend/<Name>.<Layer>/, frontend workspace in frontend/<Name>.Web/, documentation in docs/; no top-level tests/ directory. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dr-accepted-recorded EX GOV-007,GOV-017 MUST ;; Accepted decisions are recorded in the register by architecture-decision, with optional detailed records in docs/decisions/. ;; = ;; none ;; Decision-recording mechanism not in the oracle.
